provider.description: Retirement plan provider issuing the statement.

account_holder.description: Name printed after 'Account holder:'. The SAMPLE watermark is not a name. Empty string if the name is blank.

period_start_date.description: First day of the statement period, as YYYY-MM-DD.

period_end_date.description: Last day of the statement period, as YYYY-MM-DD.

total_balance.description: Total portfolio balance at the end of the period, in dollars.

personal_rate_of_return.description: Personal rate of return for the quarter, as a percentage, e.g. 5.45.

retirement_income_projection.description: The projected lifetime retirement income on the first page.

average_monthly_contribution.description: Average monthly contribution the projection is based on, in dollars.

estimated_monthly_income.description: Estimated monthly lifetime income at retirement, in dollars.

portfolio_summary.description: The quarter's column of the Summary of your portfolio activity.

asset_allocation.description: Every asset class in How your portfolio is allocated.

value.description: Value at the end of the period, in dollars.

plans.description: Every retirement plan in the statement, in order.

plan_name.description: Plan name from the plan's numbered section heading, e.g. RETIREMENT PLAN or MATCHING PLAN. Not the TIAA or CREF contract labels.

beginning_balance.description: Balance at the start of the period, in dollars.

employee_contributions.description: Your contributions line in the plan's Summary of your activity, in dollars. Null if the summary has no such line.

employer_contributions.description: Employer contributions line in the plan's Summary of your activity, in dollars. Null if the summary has no such line.

gains_losses.description: Gains or losses this period, in dollars.

ending_balance.description: Balance at the end of the period, in dollars.

vested_status.description: The Vested percent printed in the plan's What you have vested table, e.g. 100%. 'Not displayed' when the plan states that a vested percentage is not currently displayed.

tax_treatment.description: Tax treatment of the plan's investments as printed, e.g. Pre-Tax or After-Tax - ROTH.
